history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A split-screen image displays two identical close-up portraits of a young East Asian woman with her hair tied up in a messy bun, bangs framing her face. She is wearing oversized, tortoiseshell glasses with a distinctive black bow detail on the temples. Her left hand is gently resting on her cheek, and she has a soft, alluring expression with glossy pink lips and rosy cheeks. She is wearing a dark brown camisole. The background is softly blurred, showing hints of a white closet or sliding door with a light pink and white patterned textile draped over what appears to be a bed or sofa. The lighting is soft and warm, creating a dreamy and intimate atmosphere. The overall color palette is dominated by warm browns, soft pinks, and muted whites, with a slight vintage or ethereal filter applied. The mood is gentle, feminine, and slightly playful.
